title: [Bug]: ComposeContainer with containerized docker compose does not wait for command to finish
body:
### Module

Core

### Testcontainers version

1.19.3

### Using the latest Testcontainers version?

No

### Host OS

linux

### Host Arch

x86

### Docker version

```shell
docker-compose Docker Compose version v2.23.0
```


### What happened?

Containerized docker compose does not wait for commands to finish as could be seen in logs

### Relevant log output

